column.name: SEQ_USAGE_CD
column.description: FK to TLGNR_SEQ_USAGE_BS. That table contains detailed descriptions about custom sequences.

column.name: COMPANYCODE_CD
column.description: FK to tlgnr_companycode_bs. The country for which the counter is used. Major filter critieria

column.name: PLANT_CD
column.description: FK to tlgnr_plant_bs. The plant for which the counter is used. (Minor, optional filter criteria)

column.name: PREFIX
column.description: If a prefix is defined, the value in 'Next' is padded with 0, and this Prefix is prepended.

column.name: RANGE_FROM
column.description: Start value (initial value, for when counter becomes active), or when rollover happens

column.name: RANGE_TO
column.description: Maximum value. If value is exceeded, sequence starts with 'Range From' again.

column.name: VALID_FROM
column.description: The counter role is only valid after this date.

column.name: LAST_VALUE
column.description: Logon increments this value by 1 whenever it gets the next number from the sequence counter for a certain situation.

column.name: LOCKED
column.description: Read/write lock. Lock must be acquired before loading the entity and released after committing the entity

column.name: LOCKED_TS
column.description: Time of last locking. If this timestamp is older than a certain amount of time, the lock can be re-acquired
